scientific_limitations: Claim is for algebraically closed fields of characteristic zero and for first jets of rank-one determinantal varieties with 3<=m<=n.
Singular locus described with reduced scheme structure; deeper rank-at-most-one strata not analytically classified.
One cited Smith--Weyman preprint on tangent-scheme resolutions was not accessible in full; residual overlap risk remains.
title: Singular locus and ordinary-double-point slices of determinantal first-jet principal components
